content_sections.heading: IBPS Hindi Officer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold a Master's degree from a recognized university in one of the following combinations: Hindi (major/elective) with English as major or elective at graduation, OR English (major/elective) with Hindi as major or elective at graduation, OR Any subject other than Hindi/English, with Hindi as major/elective and English as medium of examination at degree level, OR Any subject other than Hindi/English, with English as major/elective and Hindi as medium of examination at degree level Degrees obtained through correspondence, distance education, or open university systems are not acceptable. One year of experience in translation work from English to Hindi and vice-versa (reports/documents/letters) in a bank/financial institution is desirable, not mandatory. Competency in operating a computer is mandatory - candidates must be able to type/create translated documents in MS Word and Excel in Hindi and English. Exposure or experience in developing AI-based tools for translation is an added qualification. Integrity should not have been doubtful during service/career No punishment/penalty during service/career No pending CBI or law enforcement cases Good knowledge of MS Office is necessary Not open to internal candidates (regular or contractual)

content_sections.heading: IBPS Hindi Officer Age Limit
content_sections.text: As on 01.09.2026 : Minimum 23 years, Maximum 30 years - i.e., candidates must be born not earlier than 02.09.1996 and not later than 01.09.2003 (both dates inclusive). IBPS reserves the right to relax or modify the age criteria for deserving candidates. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: IBPS Hindi Officer Application Fee
content_sections.text: Fee is payable online only, between 23.09.2026 and 06.10.2026 (both dates inclusive). Bank transaction charges are borne by the candidate.

content_sections.heading: IBPS Hindi Officer Salary
content_sections.text: Figures as on September 2026. Annual CTC also includes PF contribution, medical benefits, mediclaim, telephone/newspaper reimbursement, canteen subsidy, performance-linked incentive, gratuity, superannuation and other benefits as per IBPS rules. Service Bond: Selected candidates must execute a service bond of ₹2 lakhs and serve a minimum of 3 years, or pay ₹2 lakhs to IBPS.

content_sections.heading: IBPS Hindi Officer Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through: Online Examination, followed by Skill Test & Item Writing Exercise, Group Exercises, and Personal Interview, conducted at IBPS, Mumbai. There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer. No penalty for unattempted questions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IBPS Hindi Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website www.ibps.in and click "Click Here to Apply Online." Click "Click Here for New Registration" and fill in basic details to generate a provisional registration number and password. Upload photograph, signature, left thumb impression, hand-written declaration, brief resume (PDF), SSC/SSLC/10th certificate, and supporting eligibility documents as per the prescribed specifications. Pay the ₹1,000 application fee online (Debit/Credit Card, Net Banking, IMPS, UPI, or Mobile Wallets). Submit the form and download/print the e-receipt and application form for your records. Applications must be submitted only online at www.ibps.in between 23.09.2026 and 06.10.2026. No other mode of application is accepted, and no changes are allowed after final submission.

faq.question: Q1. What is IBPS Hindi Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection to fill the post of Hindi Officer (Grade E) on a regular basis, under Advertisement No. IBPS/2026-27/04.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify an exact number; candidates will be appointed against the existing vacancy, with a six-month wait list maintained separately.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A Master's degree from a recognized university in one of four specified Hindi-English subject/medium combinations, as detailed in the Eligibility section.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Minimum 23 years and maximum 30 years as on 01.09.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
Q6. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Through the official website www.ibps.in, following the registration, document upload, and fee payment steps outlined above.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for IBPS Hindi Officer?
faq.answer: Basic pay of ₹44,900 with total monthly emoluments of approximately ₹91,070 and an annual CTC of approximately ₹17.39 Lakhs.
